# License supplements

nod 1.4.4's published crate omits the repository-root license files. The copies in
`nod-1.4.4/` are from its `.cargo_vcs_info.json` revision
`df8ab228c8a8e8f906048daddc3ea07f43f18a5c`, unmodified:

https://github.com/encounter/nod/tree/df8ab228c8a8e8f906048daddc3ea07f43f18a5c

`cargo xtask notices` includes these texts when staging distribution notices.

Additional published workspace crates omit their repository-root licenses:

- `profiling` 1.0.18: unmodified MIT/Apache texts from revision
  `8271551172eb6fa4cba47369aedd93790c623df9` of https://github.com/aclysma/profiling
- `spirv` 0.4.0+sdk-1.4.341.0: unmodified LICENSE from revision
  `8afc3d0ac8e158128cd1410bb2e4b4c26ab11bb4` of https://github.com/gfx-rs/rspirv

Revisions match each crate's `.cargo_vcs_info.json`. These supplements are license
texts only, not game code or game assets.

`dasp_sample` 0.11.0 also omits workspace-root licenses. Its unmodified MIT and
Apache texts are from its `.cargo_vcs_info.json` revision
`97c3bb9b2363c0b46ac1633858bf1054fd02a980`:
https://github.com/RustAudio/dasp/tree/97c3bb9b2363c0b46ac1633858bf1054fd02a980
